# Plain Earnings

> Plain Earnings explains major public companies' quarterly earnings reports in plain English. Every report page has a one-sentence verdict, an interactive money-flow (Sankey) chart tracing each dollar from revenue to net profit, three plain-English takeaways, and figures taken only from the company's official SEC filing. Free, no account. Nothing on the site is financial advice.

## Key pages

- [Home — search all companies](https://bragdoc.net/)
- [Upcoming IPOs](https://bragdoc.net/ipos/): companies about to list, with filing terms in plain English
- [RSS feed](https://bragdoc.net/feed.xml): every new report, site-wide

## Full index and machine-readable data

- All 543 companies (S&P 500, Nasdaq-100 and major AI names) live under https://bragdoc.net/earnings/{ticker-lowercase}/ — the complete list is at https://bragdoc.net/companies.json and in the sitemap at https://bragdoc.net/sitemap.xml
- Every report page has a structured JSON twin: https://bragdoc.net/earnings/{ticker}/{fiscal-year}-q{n}/data.json (verdict, key figures, segment flows, sources)
